blockers: The repo still lacks a mounted GPUI preview app with route-level acceptance coverage comparable to the Svelte preview surface.
This suite is still artifact-backed rather than runnable downstream production proof.
Downstream GPUI adoption remains future work, so this suite should still be read as validation pressure rather than deployment readiness.

sectionReports.comparisonPosture: Compare invalid, pending, and disabled form states side by side, keeping hierarchy, token usage, field relationships, and validation exposure aligned while treating final IME and assistive-technology behavior as native review work.

Compare structured-data hierarchy, sort posture, visible selection semantics, and pagination summary across runtimes while allowing native adaptation for accessible table narration and virtualization mechanics.

Compare result hierarchy, filter posture, empty or no-results handling, and selection scaffolding side by side while allowing native list behavior and narration to adapt where the runtime genuinely differs.
Keep metadata hierarchy, card roles, action ordering, and supporting-pane posture visually and structurally close enough that side-by-side review can expose real contract drift.
Compare selection workflow, attach or choose posture, and visible state scaffolding side by side while leaving focus-scope containment and active-item narration as explicit native deltas.
Keep thumbnail, preview-state, and fallback semantics aligned at the contract level while explicitly allowing renderer and playback differences that are native-runtime specific.
Keep banners, toasts, remediation actions, and urgency posture close enough that tone, hierarchy, and recovery actions can be reviewed directly across runtimes.

Compare modal command shell posture, grouped discovery hierarchy, command ranking semantics, and shortcut presentation side by side while keeping focus recovery and announcement timing as explicit native review work.
Keep dock, split, panel, shell-header, and status-bar hierarchy materially the same across runtimes so Loophole-facing workstation defects are obvious under side-by-side review.

deltaRegister.title: Structured table and list narration remain native-adaptation work
deltaRegister.runtimeReason: HTML table and list semantics do not map directly to GPUI accessible-tree behavior, especially once selection, sorting, and virtualization enter the same surface.
deltaRegister.followUp: Reduce this delta once mounted GPUI browse and table review surfaces can prove row narration, sort-state exposure, and result-count updates.

deltaRegister.title: Overlay focus scope, dismissal, and recovery remain runtime-specific
deltaRegister.runtimeReason: Browser dialog and popover focus-scope behavior does not transfer automatically to GPUI command, picker, and workstation shells.
deltaRegister.followUp: Reduce this delta after the mounted GPUI preview app can exercise close recovery, initial focus, outside dismissal, and command or picker active-item traversal.

deltaRegister.title: Media renderer and fallback behavior are intentionally runtime-specific
deltaRegister.runtimeReason: Browser embeds, document affordances, and media playback surfaces are not expected to match GPUI one-to-one even when the same fallback and state contract is preserved.
deltaRegister.followUp: Keep the fallback, metadata, and unavailable-preview contract aligned without forcing pixel-identical renderer behavior.

deltaRegister.title: Announcement timing for notifications and command execution still needs native proof
deltaRegister.runtimeReason: Browser live-region timing and focus side effects do part of the work automatically, while GPUI will need native announcement sequencing.
deltaRegister.followUp: Reduce this delta after mounted GPUI notification and command surfaces can be exercised with real announcement traces.

deltaRegister.title: Workstation dock-region and multi-window shell behavior remain explicit native deltas
deltaRegister.runtimeReason: Dock transfer, named region traversal, menu ownership, and multi-window movement are native shell concerns that Svelte can only model indirectly.
deltaRegister.followUp: Reduce this delta after GPUI workstation shells have mounted native review routes and downstream GPUI adoption proof.

automatedBoundary: Svelte section registration, route generation, and package-surface coverage remain machine-checked through the preview parity registry.
GPUI section classification, package coverage, accessibility proof posture, and side-by-side review targets are machine-checked through this artifact and the existing baseline artifacts.
Acceptance-harness inventory and evidence paths are machine-checked through packages/ecosystem-acceptance.json.
manualBoundary: GPUI preview app is now mounted with 96 components, 73 specimens, 4-section navigation, display controls, and a 6-screen demo app; side-by-side review is backed by real rendered surfaces.
Assistive-technology traces, focus recovery feel, motion nuance, and native shell orchestration still require human review.
Allowed or revisit deltas remain explicit debt, not invisible parity exemptions.
nonGoals: Do not treat this report as downstream GPUI production deployment proof; the preview app exists but adoption is still future work.
Do not collapse runtime-specific deltas into defects when the shared contract is still preserved honestly.
Do not treat artifact-backed parity evidence as downstream GPUI adoption proof.
